summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing solely a monthly return (HKEX FF301) for June 2026, reporting routine movements in authorized and issued share capital, including a net decrease in Class A and Class B ordinary shares due to vesting/cancellation of equity awards. The filing includes no transaction, no special situation (acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.), and no event triggering a special-situation classification. It is a routine regulatory compliance submission for a Hong Kong-listed foreign private issuer.
